outcome_class_rationale: All three agencies affirmed ratings and revised outlook from Negative to Stable during window (Moody's 2023; S&P and Fitch Dec 2024). No rating notch changes — net result is positive outlook progression ending at all-stable. Could arguably be classified as AFFIRM_POSITIVE_OUTLOOK at midpoint, but final state is AFFIRM_STABLE.
